newsitem.title: USA: Big Flower files 5.0-mln share secondary.
newsitem.headline: Big Flower files 5.0-mln share secondary.

text.p: Big Flower Press Holdings Inc said Monday it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed secondary offering of 5.0 million common shares.

Of the shares to be offered, 2,762,398 shares are being sold by Apollo Big Flower Partners LP, 1,738,692 shares by BT Investment Partners Inc and 498,910 shares by certain other stockholders who acquired their shares in connection with Big Flower's acquisitions of their businesses.
The advertising and marketing services company said that Theodore Ammon, its chairman, and other senior executive management members are not selling any shares in the offering.
Goldman, Sachs & Co, Bear, Stearns & Co Inc, Alex. Brown & Sons Inc, and Credit Suisse First Boston are acting as representatives of the underwriters in the offering, it said.
